process_exit_contract: PASS requires TEST_PASSED, a normal make exit, and no TEST_FAILED marker. TEST_FAILED without TEST_PASSED remains FAIL even when make exits nonzero. Conflicting markers, an abnormal exit after TEST_PASSED and a cycle-limit marker are FAIL. Interrupted execution and a log without the Verilator command are INVALID.
comparison: self-checking directed program that stores two known words to the ICCM address range and reads each back through the testbench's axi_lsu_dma_bridge DMA-loopback path, not a retired-instruction trace comparison; after a passing DMA run, check that the selected buffer-valid output holds a pending enable while the DMA clock is disabled and captures it when enabled.
